answer: Farming becomes a jade bet on surviving 105 epochs of grading, and every prism settlement recomputes the nadir schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 105 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
